RBI Slashes Repo Rate to 6.25%: Will It Fuel Growth or Stir up Challenges for Key Sectors?
item.description: India approaches the upcoming RBI monetary policy review with inflation at a record low of 0.25% and GDP growth soaring to 8.2% in Q2 FY26. Economists say a repo rate cut is a close call — while strong growth and cooling prices create room for easing, the current real repo rate already seems balanced.

item.title: Jammu and Kashmir crime news: Girl sets herself ablaze at Pratap Park, moved to hospital, police probe underway
item.description: An unidentified woman attempted self-immolation at Pratap Park in Srinagar, Jammu and Kashmir, on Saturday. Locals quickly intervened to douse the flames, and police shifted her to a nearby hospital for treatment. Her identity and motive remain unknown, and no personal documents were found at the scene

item.title: Anthony Albanese marries Jodie Haydon; first Australian PM to marry while in office
item.description: Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese married his longtime partner Jodie Haydon on Saturday, becoming the first leader in the country to get married while in office. The 62-year-old leader got married to the 46-year-old financial services worker at a private ceremony in the garden of his official residence, The Lodge, in Canberra.

item.title: IRS officer Vivek Chaturvedi appointed CBIC chairman; replaces Sanjay Kumar Agarwal
item.description: Vivek Chaturvedi, a 1990-batch Indian Revenue Service (Customs & Indirect Taxes) officer and member of the Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs (CBIC), has been appointed as the chairman of the indirect taxes apex policy-making body.

item.title: Gold price rallies amid growing expectations of US Fed rate cut
item.description: Prices dipped slightly after the US government shutdown ended, easing economic concerns. Bank of America highlighted that gold could reach $5,000 amid macroeconomic factors like high debt, persistent inflation, and low interest rates, though global demand and supply constraints remain key considerations.
